name: [CernoIA PROD] WF-001 - Sincronización incremental SECOP II

parameters.name: $where

parameters.query:
SELECT
    source_code,
    cursor_timestamp,
    cursor_process_id,

    COALESCE(
        cursor_timestamp,
        DATE_TRUNC('day', NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days')
    ) AS sync_from

FROM ops.sync_cursors
WHERE source_code = 'SECOP_II_PROCESSES';

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ JSON.stringify($('Normalizar proceso SECOP').all(0, $runIndex).map(item => ({ cursor_timestamp: item.json.source_updated_at, cursor_process_id: item.json.secop_process_id }))) ] }}

parameters.query:
WITH cursor_update AS (
    UPDATE ops.sync_cursors
    SET
        cursor_timestamp =
            NULLIF(
                $1::TEXT,
                ''
            )::TIMESTAMPTZ,

        cursor_process_id =
            NULLIF(
                $2::TEXT,
                ''
            ),

        status = 'running',
        last_run_at = NOW(),

        records_processed =
            records_processed + $3::BIGINT,

        error_message = NULL,

        lock_expires_at =
            NOW() + INTERVAL '30 minutes',

        metadata =
            COALESCE(metadata, '{}'::JSONB)
            || jsonb_build_object(
                'last_batch_count',
                $4::BIGINT,

                'last_cursor_timestamp',
                $5::TEXT,

                'last_cursor_process_id',
                $6::TEXT,

                'current_execution_id',
                $7::TEXT,

                'current_execution_batches',
                COALESCE(
                    NULLIF(
                        metadata ->> 'current_execution_batches',
                        ''
                    )::INTEGER,
                    0
                ) + 1,

                'current_execution_records',
                COALESCE(
                    NULLIF(
                        metadata ->> 'current_execution_records',
                        ''
                    )::BIGINT,
                    0
                ) + $8::BIGINT,

                'lock_renewed_at',
                NOW()
            ),

        updated_at = NOW()

    WHERE source_code = 'SECOP_II_PROCESSES'
      AND active_execution_id = $9::TEXT

    RETURNING
        source_code,
        cursor_timestamp,
        cursor_process_id,
        status,
        active_execution_id,
        lock_acquired_at,
        lock_expires_at,
        records_processed,
        metadata,
        updated_at
),

run_update AS (
    UPDATE ops.workflow_runs
    SET
        batches_processed =
            batches_processed + 1,

        records_read =
            records_read + $10::BIGINT,

        records_written =
            records_written + $11::BIGINT,

        cursor_end_timestamp =
            NULLIF(
                $12::TEXT,
                ''
            )::TIMESTAMPTZ,

        cursor_end_process_id =
            NULLIF(
                $13::TEXT,
                ''
            ),

        updated_at = NOW()

    WHERE n8n_execution_id = $14::TEXT
      AND status = 'running'

    RETURNING
        id,
        n8n_execution_id,
        batches_processed,
        records_read,
        records_written,
        cursor_end_timestamp,
        cursor_end_process_id
)

SELECT
    cursor_update.source_code,
    cursor_update.cursor_timestamp,
    cursor_update.cursor_process_id,
    cursor_update.status,
    cursor_update.active_execution_id,
    cursor_update.lock_acquired_at,
    cursor_update.lock_expires_at,
    cursor_update.records_processed,
    cursor_update.metadata,

    run_update.id AS workflow_run_id,
    run_update.batches_processed,
    run_update.records_read,
    run_update.records_written,
    run_update.cursor_end_timestamp,
    run_update.cursor_end_process_id

FROM cursor_update
LEFT JOIN run_update ON TRUE;

UPDATE ops.sync_cursors
SET
    active_execution_id = $1::TEXT,

    lock_acquired_at = NOW(),
    lock_expires_at = NOW() + INTERVAL '30 minutes',

    status = 'running',
    last_run_at = NOW(),
    error_message = NULL,

    metadata = COALESCE(metadata, '{}'::JSONB)
        || jsonb_build_object(
            'current_execution_id',
            $2::TEXT,

            'current_execution_batches',
            0,

            'current_execution_records',
            0,

            'current_execution_started_at',
            NOW()
        ),

    updated_at = NOW()

WHERE source_code = 'SECOP_II_PROCESSES'

  AND (
      active_execution_id IS NULL
      OR lock_expires_at IS NULL
      OR lock_expires_at <= NOW()
      OR active_execution_id = $3::TEXT
  )

RETURNING
    source_code,
    cursor_timestamp,
    cursor_process_id,

    records_processed,

    active_execution_id,
    lock_acquired_at,
    lock_expires_at,

    status,
    metadata;

WITH cursor_snapshot AS (
    SELECT
        cursor_timestamp,
        cursor_process_id,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                metadata ->> 'current_execution_batches',
                ''
            )::INTEGER,
            0
        ) AS current_batches,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                metadata ->> 'current_execution_records',
                ''
            )::BIGINT,
            0
        ) AS current_records

    FROM ops.sync_cursors

    WHERE source_code = 'SECOP_II_PROCESSES'
      AND active_execution_id = $1::TEXT
),

run_finished AS (
    UPDATE ops.workflow_runs AS workflow_run
    SET
        status = 'success',
        finished_at = NOW(),

        batches_processed =
            cursor_snapshot.current_batches,

        records_read =
            cursor_snapshot.current_records,

        records_written =
            cursor_snapshot.current_records,

        cursor_end_timestamp =
            cursor_snapshot.cursor_timestamp,

        cursor_end_process_id =
            cursor_snapshot.cursor_process_id,

        completion_reason =
            $2::TEXT,

        error_node = NULL,
        error_message = NULL,
        error_details = '{}'::JSONB,

        metadata =
            COALESCE(
                workflow_run.metadata,
                '{}'::JSONB
            )
            || jsonb_build_object(
                'completion_reason',
                $3::TEXT,

                'finished_execution_id',
                $4::TEXT,

                'finished_at',
                NOW()
            ),

        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM cursor_snapshot

    WHERE workflow_run.n8n_execution_id =
        $5::TEXT

    RETURNING
        workflow_run.id,
        workflow_run.n8n_execution_id,
        workflow_run.status,
        workflow_run.started_at,
        workflow_run.finished_at,
        workflow_run.batches_processed,
        workflow_run.records_read,
        workflow_run.records_written,
        workflow_run.cursor_start_timestamp,
        workflow_run.cursor_start_process_id,
        workflow_run.cursor_end_timestamp,
        workflow_run.cursor_end_process_id,
        workflow_run.completion_reason
),

cursor_released AS (
    UPDATE ops.sync_cursors
    SET
        active_execution_id = NULL,
        lock_acquired_at = NULL,
        lock_expires_at = NULL,

        status = 'success',
        last_success_at = NOW(),
        error_message = NULL,

        metadata =
            (
                COALESCE(metadata, '{}'::JSONB)
                - 'current_execution_id'
            )
            || jsonb_build_object(
                'last_completion_reason',
                $6::TEXT,

                'last_completed_execution_id',
                $7::TEXT,

                'last_completed_at',
                NOW(),

                'last_execution_batches',
                COALESCE(
                    NULLIF(
                        metadata ->> 'current_execution_batches',
                        ''
                    )::INTEGER,
                    0
                ),

                'last_execution_records',
                COALESCE(
                    NULLIF(
                        metadata ->> 'current_execution_records',
                        ''
                    )::BIGINT,
                    0
                )
            ),

        updated_at = NOW()

    WHERE source_code = 'SECOP_II_PROCESSES'
      AND active_execution_id = $8::TEXT

    RETURNING
        source_code,
        cursor_timestamp,
        cursor_process_id,
        status,
        active_execution_id,
        lock_acquired_at,
        lock_expires_at,
        last_success_at,
        metadata,
        updated_at
)

SELECT
    cursor_released.source_code,
    cursor_released.cursor_timestamp,
    cursor_released.cursor_process_id,
    cursor_released.status,
    cursor_released.active_execution_id,
    cursor_released.lock_acquired_at,
    cursor_released.lock_expires_at,
    cursor_released.last_success_at,
    cursor_released.metadata,

    run_finished.id AS workflow_run_id,
    run_finished.n8n_execution_id,
    run_finished.started_at,
    run_finished.finished_at,
    run_finished.batches_processed,
    run_finished.records_read,
    run_finished.records_written,
    run_finished.cursor_start_timestamp,
    run_finished.cursor_start_process_id,
    run_finished.cursor_end_timestamp,
    run_finished.cursor_end_process_id,
    run_finished.completion_reason

FROM cursor_released
LEFT JOIN run_finished ON TRUE;

INSERT INTO ops.workflow_runs (
    workflow_code,
    source_code,
    n8n_execution_id,
    trigger_type,
    status,
    started_at,

    cursor_start_timestamp,
    cursor_start_process_id,

    metadata,

    created_at,
    updated_at
)
VALUES (
    'WF-001',
    'SECOP_II_PROCESSES',
    $1::TEXT,
    $2::TEXT,
    'running',
    NOW(),

    NULLIF(
        $3::TEXT,
        ''
    )::TIMESTAMPTZ,

    NULLIF(
        $4::TEXT,
        ''
    ),

    jsonb_build_object(
        'workflow_name',
        'WF-001 - Sincronización incremental SECOP II',

        'lock_acquired_at',
        NULLIF(
            $5::TEXT,
            ''
        )::TIMESTAMPTZ,

        'lock_expires_at',
        NULLIF(
            $6::TEXT,
            ''
        )::TIMESTAMPTZ
    ),

    NOW(),
    NOW()
)

ON CONFLICT (n8n_execution_id)
DO UPDATE SET
    status = 'running',
    updated_at = NOW()

RETURNING
    id,
    workflow_code,
    source_code,
    n8n_execution_id,
    trigger_type,
    status,
    started_at,
    cursor_start_timestamp,
    cursor_start_process_id,
    metadata;

INSERT INTO ops.workflow_runs (
    workflow_code,
    source_code,
    n8n_execution_id,
    trigger_type,
    status,
    started_at,
    finished_at,
    completion_reason,
    metadata,
    created_at,
    updated_at
)
VALUES (
    'WF-001',
    'SECOP_II_PROCESSES',
    $1::TEXT,
    $2::TEXT,
    'skipped',
    NOW(),
    NOW(),
    'concurrent_execution',

    jsonb_build_object(
        'reason',
        'Otra ejecución tiene un bloqueo vigente',

        'attempted_execution_id',
        $3::TEXT,

        'registered_at',
        NOW()
    ),

    NOW(),
    NOW()
)

ON CONFLICT (n8n_execution_id)
DO UPDATE SET
    status = 'skipped',
    finished_at = NOW(),
    completion_reason = 'concurrent_execution',

    metadata =
        COALESCE(
            ops.workflow_runs.metadata,
            '{}'::JSONB
        )
        || jsonb_build_object(
            'reason',
            'Otra ejecución tiene un bloqueo vigente',

            'registered_at',
            NOW()
        ),

    updated_at = NOW()

RETURNING
    id,
    workflow_code,
    n8n_execution_id,
    trigger_type,
    status,
    started_at,
    finished_at,
    completion_reason,
    metadata;

WITH rewind AS (
 UPDATE ops.sync_cursors SET
  metadata=COALESCE(metadata,'{}'::jsonb)||jsonb_build_object('last_reconciliation_at',NOW(),'source_high_watermark',GREATEST(cursor_timestamp,NULLIF(metadata->>'source_high_watermark','')::timestamptz)),
  cursor_timestamp=cursor_timestamp-INTERVAL '7 days',cursor_process_id='',updated_at=NOW()
 WHERE source_code='SECOP_II_PROCESSES' AND active_execution_id=$1::text
  AND cursor_timestamp IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(metadata->>'last_reconciliation_at','')::timestamptz,'1970-01-01')<NOW()-INTERVAL '24 hours'
  AND cursor_timestamp>=NOW()-INTERVAL '4 days'
 RETURNING source_code
) SELECT source_code FROM ops.sync_cursors WHERE source_code='SECOP_II_PROCESSES';
